text:
alex: Quick thread — I'm drafting the internal RN for tomorrow's micro-release. Need pin owner, short TL;DR, and deploybot schedule. Target cutover 2026-03-23 15:30 UTC. Canaries + rollback criteria needed.

maria: I can handle copy. Will trim to 3 bullets + one-sentence impact. Recommend canary 10% for 15m.

sophie: I can be pin owner. Staging dry-run scheduled 13:00 UTC. Please add the rollback criteria we agreed last week: error spike >=5% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency > 800ms for 5m.

noah: ops note — deploybot command I'd run (staging -> prod) once you confirm:
```
/deploy schedule --job "micro-release-2026-03-23" --canary 10 --canary-duration 15m --cutover 2026-03-23T15:30:00Z --notify #eng-oncall
```
Make sure the deploybot has the pinned model tag set to `v2.3.1-pinA`.

maria: added a small TL;DR to the doc: https://docs.internal/releases/micro-2026-03-23 — text: "perf-focused patch, no schema changes, expect transient canary errors if cache warms". Sophie, can you attach the pinned release link in the console?

deploybot: Scheduled job 7890 created by noah. Canary=10%, cutover=2026-03-23T15:30:00Z, notify=#eng-oncall. Reminder set for 15:00 UTC. Reply `cancel 7890` to abort.

alex: Perfect. Sophie — please post the internal announcement at 15:10 UTC with the RN link and the oncall cadence. Also include the rollback table: thresholds + owners + commands.

sophie: Will post at 15:10. Rollback table draft (will paste to RN):
- trigger: error spike >=5% for 10m -> action: revert to `v2.3.0` -> owner: @dev-oncall -> command: `/deploy rollback --job 7890 --to-tag v2.3.0`
- trigger: sustained high latency p95 > 800ms for 5m -> action: scale down new processes + fallback model -> owner: @dev-oncall -> ops runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/latency-fallback

dev-oncall: I'll be on standby 15:00-16:00 UTC. Confirm I have the rollback keys and access.

maria: small copy tweak: add "If you see regressions, ping #eng-oncall immediately". Also I'm pinning the 1-line summary at top.

alex: thanks team. Last checks: deploybot reminder at 15:00, staging dry-run 13:00, announcement 15:10, cutover 15:30. If any change, update this thread. :thumbsup:

sophie: posting internal announcement now to staff channels and pinning RN. Will include the deploybot job id and rollback table. :rocket:
